articles.title: Superman, a Handmaid, and a Rival Walk Into a Rainstorm!
articles.summary: Imagine a play where a secret is hidden in the rain. Three big stars—Superman actor David Corenswet, Yvonne Strahovski, and François Arnaud—will uncover it on Broadway in 2027. The last time this play was on Broadway, Julia Roberts made her stage debut!

articles.title: A Giant Hug on the Grass: 23,000 Square Feet of Art Brings a City Together
articles.summary: Picture a painting so big it covers a whole park! In Minneapolis, artist Saype created a huge artwork of clasping arms on the grass. It's made of eco-friendly paint that fades away. Hundreds of people held hands to celebrate their community's strength.

articles.title: Einstein's Light Cones Come to Life in the Desert Sky!
articles.summary: What if you could see time and space painted with light? Physicist and photographer Elliot McGucken uses a drone to draw glowing cones in the sky over deserts. They're based on Einstein's idea of a "light cone"—like an hourglass made of light!
